title: What if a cyclone and floods hit the northeast

headlines.title: Depression in the Bay of Bengal strengthens into a cyclone heading for Sri Lanka's northeast coast
Heavy rain floods Batticaloa and Ampara districts in Eastern Province
Government declares flood disaster zones and closes schools in the east
Cyclone makes landfall near Trincomalee and cuts power across the Eastern Province
Farmers report paddy and vegetable losses across the northeast
Government announces relief package and loan moratorium for flood-hit farmers
